purpose: Teach: もどっ/はさん/つくし/心中/少く/いれる/前もって/申しわけ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室にもどってきたな
lines.en: Riku — you came back to class.
lines.style: Observing something small about him. Casual, testing tone. No judgment, just noticing. Open curiosity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教科書にしおりをはさんでたな、桜
lines.en: You had a bookmark in your textbook, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Notices small details without making a show of it. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、春につくし摘みに行ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you went to pick tsukushi in spring.
lines.style: Catching him in a small moment he probably doesn't talk about. Gentle teasing. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、心中、テスト不安だろ?桜
lines.en: You're anxious about the test, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Not quite a question. Quiet certainty. He's seen it on her before. Soft, not pressing. The safety of being truly seen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近食欲が少くなったな
lines.en: Riku — you haven't been eating much lately.
lines.style: Noticing the worry she hasn't said out loud. Direct but not confrontational. A step closer in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、部活帰り、ジュースをいれるの上手いな、桜
lines.en: You're good at pouring juice after club, Sakura.
lines.style: Small, genuine praise. Not big or showy. The kind of thing he wouldn't usually say out loud. Slight warmth, slight awkwardness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、前もって連絡くれよ
lines.en: Riku — give me a heads-up next time.
lines.style: Less teasing now. Closer to a request. A little vulnerable underneath the directness. Needs to know he can count on her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「申しわけ」って先生に謝ってたな、桜
lines.en: You apologized to the teacher like that, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate. A small laugh caught underneath. He's both teasing her sincerity and touched by it. Dry observation with warm eyes.
